 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. With the Bundesliga returning after the last international break of 2027, Bayer Leverkusen will be keen to bounce back to winning ways this afternoon as SC Paderborn come to town.
 With around an hour to go until the scheduled 15:30 CET kick-off, both head coaches have revealed their starting lineups – you can see them in full below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Bayer Leverkusen vs. SC Paderborn lineups:
 Leverkusen (4-2-3-1): Flekken – Quansah, Tapsoba, Badé, Gutierrez – Fernandez, Garcia – Tella, Tillman, Moreira – Schick
 Paderborn (3-3-2-2): Noll – Ter Horst, Scheller, Hansen – Curda, Castañeda, Obermair – Baack, Vidović – Marino, Müller
